sections.Description:
Star Wars themed Comic Art pinball machines feature the artwork of one of today’s most popular artists, Randy Martinez.

Randy has been illustrating for over 30 years receiving countless accolades of his work. Through a broad spectrum of his skills, Randy has been creating cartoons, caricatures, illustrations, paintings, and 3D art for Lucasfilm since 1999.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Destroy the Death Star: Shoot the modulating ramp to Destroy the Death Star and experience the interactive hyperspace loop to relive your favorite scenes right out of the movie.
- Directly from the Movies!: Select from 4 different characters, 4 Locations that feature 3 different modes, and play multiballs all featuring speech and footage from the original Star Wars trilogy.
- New Artwork!: Star Wars themed Comic Art pinball machines feature the artwork of one of today’s most popular artists, Randy Martinez.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- With 400 HD video scenes from the original films, featuring the Original John Williams Star Wars music.
- Star Wars themed Comic Art pinball machines feature the artwork of one of today’s most popular artists, Randy Martinez.
- All models feature the SPIKE-2 Electronic System, & 2 HD displays, including an LCD display on the playfield with Multifunction RGB Action Button.

Premium:
- 4 playable Characters, 16 Missions, 1 Wizard Mode with 9 distinct Multiball Modes deliver incredible depth and breadth of play.
- Star Wars themed Comic Art pinball machines feature the artwork of one of today’s most popular artists, Randy Martinez.
- Powder coated steel bottom arch with Powder coated wrinkle finish legs, side armor, hinges, and front lockdown molding.
